product_metadata.title: Convenience Concepts Designs4Comfort Storage Ottoman, Black
features: Triples as a Footrest, Chair and Storage Unit
Button Tufting, Hinged Lid and Nailhead Trim
Convenient hinged lid stays up while placing items in storage area
description: The Designs4Comfort 5th Avenue Storage Ottoman by Convenience Concepts will bring style and functionality to any room in your home. This elegant ottoman showcases a gorgeous button tufted hinged lid paired perfectly with the accented nailhead trim. Open the hinged lid to reveal the perfect amount of storage to keep your space clutter free. The solid wood turned feet ensure that this piece will be as reliable as it is beautiful. Available in a variety of finishes and fabrics from faux leather to velvet there is sure to be a finish that will fit the comfort of your home.
